title: 381 Event Space
description: 381 Event Space in Braunschweig combines flexible architectural zoning, modular stage configurations, and atmospheric lighting for next-generation brand events and creative summits.

title: Cycla
description: Cycla explores sustainable micro-mobility and modular spatial storage, integrating industrial product design with minimal architectural showroom installations.

title: Ding Dong Ping Pong
description: Ding Dong Ping Pong is an interactive social installation in Berlin that combines recreational sport, vibrant industrial materials, and dynamic spatial design.

title: Dojo
description: Where History Meets High Contrast. MESHACK reimagines DOJO's Kreuzberg headquarters—a former church transformed into a high-performance creative hub defined by sleek materials, acoustic precision, and an iconic domed centerpiece.

title: Kantine Komtur
description: Kantine Komtur blends historical architectural heritage with contemporary hospitality design, creating an inviting culinary destination in Berlin.

title: Lokal Vier
description: For Lokal Vier in Hanover, MESHACK created a warm, contemporary restaurant concept designed as an all-day, 24/7 meeting place. The space combines a cozy, inviting atmosphere with a cool, modern aesthetic, encouraging guests to stay, connect, and return at any time of day.

title: Ohm Club
description: OHM, one of Berlin's most iconic electronic music clubs, was conceived, designed and built in collaboration with MESHACK. The space translates the energy of electronic music into a minimal, atmospheric environment focused on sound, rhythm and community.

title: Reforma X People People
description: Located in the heart of Cologne's Belgian Quarter, this dual-concept space by MESHACK blends urban energy with mindful movement. A harmonious interplay of raw concrete, warm timber, and refined lighting.

title: Slyrs Experience Centre
description: The Slyrs Experience Centre at Lake Schliersee offers an immersive journey through the world of whisky with interactive installations and sensory experiences inspired by the surrounding landscape.

title: Tresor Globus
description: MESHACK redesigned the Globus floor at Tresor Berlin with a new spatial concept that redefines one of the club's most iconic spaces. A reworked layout, centrally positioned bar, and flexible room structure create a dynamic balance between dance floor and lounge areas, adaptable to different event formats. Combined with full-surface sound absorbers and the Lambda sound system, the redesign merges architecture, acoustics, and atmosphere into one cohesive club experience.
